==== Reset Character & Show Stats Options ====
by Vizyne



== WHAT THIS DOES ==
1) Adds an option to reset a character's stats/progression, allowing you to play from Level 1 again.
	This prevents you from having to use a whole new save slot if you want to play through the game again with a character you've already beaten the game with.

2) Adds a "Completion Counter", which shows how many times you've beaten the game with a character.

3) Adds an option to view playtime stats:
	- Enemies Killed
	- Generators Destroyed
	- Gold Found
	- Time Played
	- Game Completions (New feature)

This prevents you from having to use a whole new save slot if you want to play through the game again with a character you've already beaten the game with.


== KNOWN ISSUES ==
None


== HOW TO USE ==
To reset your character:
	- Hover over the character in the character select screen.
	- Press "X". This prompts you with a message asking if you want to reset the selected character.
	- To reset, press "A" (YES). To cancel, press "B" (NO).

To view your stats:
	- Hover over the character in the character select screen.
	- Press "Y". This shows you all of your character's playtime stats.
	- Press "Y" again to exit the screen.
